simulatedHarnessNote: Harness detection in v1.22.0 is configuration-path based (src/bootstrap/connect.ts detectInstalledHarnesses). Every harness presence this run is a simulated marker directory in an isolated HOME/XDG; no real codex or opencode process was launched and no real harness config was touched.

assertions.ambientEndpointsRemoved: CAMPFIRE_URL and CAMPFIRE_TOKEN removed from every child environment
assertions.isolatedDirs: HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, CAMPFIRE_CONFIG_DIR, CAMPFIRE_DATA_DIR, TMPDIR per scenario
assertions.userIdentity: USER=LOGNAME=owner for a deterministic name-prompt default
assertions.noRealBrowser: CAMPFIRE_NO_BROWSER=1, --no-open, or a PATH `open` shim that only logs the URL
assertions.noLastingHarness: no harness process is started; detection is filesystem-only

methodNotes.launch: `campfire view --port 0` binds a real loopback listener; the URL is read from the `[campfire] viewer listening on http://127.0.0.1:<port>` stderr line
methodNotes.actorBinding: the browser never receives a token; the Viewer process resolves the acting human from the isolated profile (E2/E3: the profile created by `campfire --human-name Rob`; E1/E4: no profile, so the CLI default actor id `hum_sergio` from src/cli/index.ts is used and does not exist in the store)
methodNotes.emptyStates: E1/E4: with no profile the store has no such actor, so list_workspaces fails with ActorNotFound and the generated route falls through to a 500 InternalError (ActorNotFound is not in the route's 404 mapping at src/viewer/server.ts). E2/E3: an initialized local profile with no workspace sees `{"ok":true,"result":[]}` and the rendered empty state `Waiting for an agent to start work.`
methodNotes.servedAssets: GET /, /app.css, /app.js, /campfire-mark.svg are served from src/viewer/static/ with their content-length and content-type; the served app.js is byte-identical to both src/viewer/static/app.js and the published public/app.js copy in the v1.22.0 worktree
methodNotes.hostGuard: a request whose Host header is not this listener's address/port is refused with 403 before any route runs (src/viewer/server.ts, PSA-001)
methodNotes.writeGuard: POST /api/call with a method outside VIEWER_READ_METHODS is refused with 403 `Viewer is read-only` before options.call is reached
methodNotes.headlessDump: `chrome-headless-shell --dump-dom --virtual-time-budget=4000` fetches the served page and dumps the DOM after the page's initial /api/call round-trip; the browser runs with an isolated --user-data-dir inside the scenario and the scenario HOME/TMPDIR. No person's browser profile is used.
methodNotes.shutdown: every viewer is stopped with a real SIGINT to its process group and exits 0 with `[campfire] received SIGINT, shutting down`

maskingRules: see BASELINE_PIN.md — cft-shaped credential tokens -> [redacted]; cfe-shaped invitation secrets -> [one-time-credential: redacted]; enrollment invitation ids (ein_inv_<16 hex>) -> ein_inv_[id]; absolute /Users, /private, /var/folders, /tmp paths -> [path]; loopback ports -> [port]; ISO timestamps -> [timestamp]; UUIDs -> [uuid]; object ids (<prefix>_<16 hex>) -> <prefix>_[id]
